Success in this role requires sound judgement, a proactive approach to delivering milestones and consistent delivery aligned with company standards. multi country teams, including employer of record providers• Experience with an HRIS such as Personioand HR platformssuch asLattice• Experience with Jira for tracking and managing work• Hands on experience using Claude or similar AI assistants to support HR work• Knowledge of compensation benchmarking or job levelling• A coaching qualification or systemic HR methodologyWhy you will love MaltegoMaltego is a scale-up company. Mine, merge, and map all your essential intelligence in one place, and uncover hidden truths with Maltego!Learn more about how we can empower your investigations at www.maltego.com.

Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams. TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.  For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) as Instrument Scientist TOFTOF (m/f/d) Tasks and Responsibilities You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.  Your tasks include:  Scientific lead of TOFTOF's further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications. Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOF Experimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performance Method development in the area of neutron spectroscopy Operation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operation Pursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methods Your responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.  Qualification and Experience PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field. Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.  Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.  Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial. Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profile Persuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset. For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.de The high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees. Benefits We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such as  TUM's health offers University sports  TUM's internal continuing education and training opportunities TUM childcare (subject to availability)  Very good accessibility by public transport The position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed. Contract We are looking forward to your application via our online-portal https://karriere.frm2.tum.de until  26.11.2026.  Here you may also find other job vacancies at FRM II: https://karriere.frm2.tum.de   Technische Universität München Forschungsneutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) Personalbüro Lichtenbergstraße 1 D-85748 Garching Tel: +49 89 289 12305 oder 14910    www.mlz-garching.de www.frm2.tum.de   As part of your application, you provide personal data to the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Please view our privacy policy on collecting and processing personal data in the course of the application process pursuant to Art. 13 of the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (GDPR) at https://portal.my-tum.de/kompass/datenschutz/Bewerbung/. By submitting your application, you confirm to have read and under-stood the data protection information (https://www.tum.de/spezialseiten/datenschutz/) provided by TUM.

Represent the bioinformatics team in cross-functional projects and regulatory interactionsOur expectations- Master's or PhD degree in Bioinformatics, Informatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related field- At least 3 years of relevant experience working in a regulated environment (preferably GxP) in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or a similarly regulated industry. - Demonstrated experience developing, validating and documenting software for a GxP-regulated environment and according to current regulations (preferably GAMP5)- Sound knowledge of Software Life-Cycle Management according to pharmaceutical industry best practice and current regulations (including versioning, code review, change & risk management)- Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL is expected (knowledge in R, Java, or JavaScript is a plus)- Knowledge in the creation of User Interfaces is a plus- Ideally, experience in conceptualizing, programming, training and testing of ML models - jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Robotics Experte; Fernsteuerer/in (Robotik); Roboterbediener/in; KI-Trainer/inStellenbeschreibung:DeutschBerufsbezeichnung: Teleoperator / Teleoperatorin (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR (Praktikum mit Option auf Festanstellung)Über unsWir entwickeln die Technologie, mit der Roboter in der echten Welt sehen, verstehen und handeln können – in Lagern und Fabriken, nicht im Labor. jobs.description: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work (https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/) list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH Join a group of talent acquisition experts who are the top of their field for attracting and hiring the top of every other field. We manage the full candidate lifecycle and just as Bain is only as good as its people, its people are only as good as our process. If you’re interested in learning how a top management consulting firm creates an impressive candidate experience, this is the team for you.WHAT YOU’LL DO - As Associate, Recruiting (m/f/d), you will support our Intern Hire Team in attracting outstanding talent for consulting internships across our offices in Germany & Austria.- In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for all candidates throughout the Talent Journey – from the initial contact at a university event through to candidate support during our assessment days.- You will also be responsible for the pre-selection of the most promising candidates for our selection process and will oversee the preparation, execution and follow-up of our assessment days.- You give free rein to your creativity in conceptualizing, planning and executing our campus activities and (flagship) recruiting events, and collaborate with your team colleagues to develop strategies and concepts to further advance our intern hiring.- With your communicative and approachable manner, you also support our internal consultants with all recruiting-related queries.- To make our recruiting success measurable, you regularly prepare analyses along the Talent Journey and present these to your key stakeholders.ABOUT YOU- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward. - You are a resilient and assertive organisational talent who does not shy away from challenges and keeps a cool head under pressure.- You truly thrive in a team setting, built on a foundation of loyalty and reliability.- You are creative, have a sense of humor and impress with a warm and positive presence.YOUR EXPERIENCE- You hold a successfully completed university degree in business administration, social sciences or law, ideally with a focus on human resources management.- You bring initial experience in recruiting and/or campus marketing. - You are proficient in MS Office; initial knowledge of data analytics is an advantage.- Your German and English language skills are excellent, both spoken and writtenWHAT WE OFFER YOUIn addition to an attractive and performance-based remuneration comprising fixed and variable components, you will benefit from numerous additional perks:- Diverse training formats, language courses as well as buddy and mentoring programmes support your personal development- You benefit from the EGYM Wellpass and further offerings for fitness and mental wellbeing- Our mobility concept gives you the flexibility to choose between Mobility Cash, reimbursement of your public transport ticket or JobRad leasing- For us, flexibility means having the best of both worlds: the freedom to work from home and the opportunity to experience genuine team moments in the office – fully in line with our Work@Bain 2.x concept.- With our Community Impact Day and participation in Green Teams, you can make a meaningful difference for society and the environment- Affinity Groups such as Women@Bain promote exchange, networking and career development- Whether Team Retreat, Christmas Party or the „Bain-Wiesn“ – you will experience how fun and team spirit go hand in hand at Bain.- Whether free snacks, beverages or the subsidised catering in our cafeteria (in Munich) – you will find even more at Bain that makes your working day a little bit better.HOW YOU´LL JOIN USHave we sparked your curiosity about an exceptional career with us? We look forward to receiving your complete application (CV, cover letter, certificates, references) via our application portal.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Befragungen (Interviews) durchführen, Datenanalyse, Personalrekrutierung, Messen, Kongresse und Veranstaltungen planen und durchführen, Bewerberauswahl, -beurteilung

About the rolePlease apply via our recruitment agency 8bit via https://8bitplay.com/jobs/level-designer/By applying you agree for your data to be processed by 8Bit for the purposes of this recruitment.Your responsibilitiesWe're looking for a Senior Level Designer to build and fill the large open world of our next factory game in Unreal Engine 5.The world needs to be rewarding to explore and give players great places to build. Over the course of the game, the world also changes visibly in response to what the player does.You'll be the first level designer on a new game team. No factory game experience required.What You'll DoYour responsibilities• Own the entire level design for the whole game• Create exploration spaces, points of interest and environmental storytelling• Shape where and how players build their factories• Work with design, art and engineering on tools, workflows and performance• Playtest and iterateWhat We're Looking ForYou will likely have:• Shipped level or world design on an open-world or large-environment game• Strong Unreal Engine 5 editor skills• A portfolio that shows your process from blockout to final• Clear communication and documentation• Experience with PCG, World Partition or Blueprints• A good understanding of artistic fundamentals for set dressingIn addition, you may have:• Experience with survival, exploration or simulation games• An interest in factory gamesWhat We Offer• Fully Remote: We employ directly inside Germany• Flexible working hours!• Paid overtime, on the rare occasions it happens• An office budget to ensure you have the ergonomic setup and hardware you need to work comfortably• A monthly personal growth allowance for courses, books or other learning material• Focus days to research or learn new skills• A yearly team gathering to meet and collaborate in person• A yearly salary review to keep your pay in line with the market, and an automatic increase of 2% per year• Hardware & home office budget (2.000€ when joining, then 1.000€ yearly).• Job Ticket (if you live in Germany).Next Steps & How to ApplyPlease apply via https://8bitplay.com/jobs/level-designer/About usWe are a small indie studio that makes factory and automation games. We started with web games and found our success on PC. Our current 17 staff come from 5 continents, with a diverse range of experiences and backgrounds. We value direct communication and ownership over bureaucracy. We design for our players, in close collaboration with our community.We work completely remote and in English; professional working proficiency is enough. We have critical meetings and collaborate with other staff during CET core working hours (approx. 11:00-15:00).We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, genders, ages, abilities and identities, and we evaluate everyone on the same criteria.
